capabilities.goal: Check this computer's AnyWeb setup and optionally install this package as the only copy.
Save the shared Portal token from standard input, optionally replacing an existing token.
Remove the saved Portal token from this computer.
Show which account this computer is signed in as, with its token masked.
List this account's website-repair requests and their queue status.
Save a website login read from standard input for a site and role.
Show whether a website login is saved for a site and role.
Delete a saved website login for a site and role.
Save a website security answer that the website just accepted.
Show masked counts of saved security answers for a site and role.
Delete saved security answers for a site and role.
Start a website fill task from a request supplied on standard input.
Show the state of one task.
Provide requested facts to a waiting task, or request an email passcode resend.
Cancel a task and close its runtime.
Print the final result of a finished task.
Delete answers an earlier version stored for a user and site.
Check whether the signed local runtime is installed and verified.
Download and verify the runtime declared by this package.
Send user-approved feature-request or bug-report feedback to Tell Jacky.
List feedback sent from this computer.
Show the status of one piece of feedback.
Show unread feedback replies and updates.
Mark one feedback reply or update as read.
Join a pair session with Jacky's assistant.
Show whether a pair connection is open.
Send current product status in an envelope to the pair session.
Show unread instructions from Jacky's assistant.
Mark an instruction from Jacky's assistant as read after it has been shown.
Send the outcome of a requested pair-session action, optionally with an error reason.
End the pair session.
Run the MCP stdio server for the host's task-status, resume, and saved-login cache loop.
Print the command surface as JSON.
